content.short: Time Shifters powered by Heuristic Labs.
content.description: Heuristic Labs is a company based in Baltic States which focuses on bringing the simulation of human intelligence processes by machines, especially computer systems into NFT space. We're glad to announce our first CNFT project ''Time Shifters''. A unique generative art collection with the utility never seen in NFT space! We provide a completely functional AI generator software that doesn't require any coding; all you have to do is submit a text prompt, and the app's AI will turn your words into masterpieces.
